_about: Every string the three interfaces show. Placeholders in braces come from the event settings or the invite. {event} is the event name the admin sets. Keep the voice: warm, calm, a little mysterious. No dashes between clauses, no emojis, sentence case on buttons.

preview_card._about: Open Graph title and description for every invite link. Same for every guest. Never any event details.
preview_card.og_description: A sealed invitation. It opens for one person.
preview_card.og_image_alt: A sealed cream envelope with a red wax seal on deep green

lock.title: This envelope is sealed
lock.key_help: It's at the bottom of the message you received.
lock.error_mismatch: That doesn't match this envelope. Check the number and the key, then try again.
lock.error_attempts_left: {n} tries left before this envelope rests for a while.
lock.error_locked: This envelope is resting after too many tries. Come back in {minutes} minutes, or ask {inviter_hint} to reset it.
lock.error_network: The connection dropped. Your details are safe. Tap Break the seal again.

stranger._about: Shown when the invite is already claimed on another phone, or the link is invalid. Never reveal names, dates or prices.
stranger.title: This invite was made for someone else
stranger.body: Invitations here are personal. Know a member? Ask them.
stranger.already_claimed: This envelope has already been opened on another phone. If it's yours, ask the person who invited you to reset it.

transfer.title: Lock your seat
transfer.intro: Transfer the exact amount below from any bank app. Your card unlocks once we confirm it.
transfer.refund_default: All payments are final. No refunds.
transfer.sender_name_label: Name on the account you sent from
transfer.sender_name_help: This helps us match your transfer quickly.
transfer.not_now_note: Your seat stays held until {expires_at}. Come back through the same link.
transfer.sender_name_placeholder: As it appears on your bank app
transfer.sender_name_error: Add the name on the account you sent from.
transfer.mid_payment_note: These details are yours until you pay, even if the hosts change accounts.
transfer.no_account: The transfer details are almost ready. Check back in a little while.

awaiting.title: Your card is being pressed
awaiting.body: We're confirming your transfer. It usually doesn't take long, and this page will update on its own.
awaiting.small: You can close this page. Your link will bring you straight back.
awaiting.member_body: Your seat is being paid for. Your card unlocks the moment the hosts confirm it.

not_found.title: We couldn't find that transfer yet
not_found.body: Check that the amount was exactly {amount} and went to {account_name}. If it went through, tap I've sent it again and we'll look once more.

covered.title: You're covered
covered.body: {inviter} has already taken care of it.

ticket.name: {guest}
ticket.no_count: You fought the No button {n} times.
ticket.qr_note: One scan, one entry. Keep it on your phone.
ticket.no_count_one: You fought the No button once.
ticket.saved: Your card is saved. Show it at the door if your network drops.
ticket.calendar_locked: The date is still sealed. It goes in your calendar once it's revealed.
ticket.save_hint: Press and hold the card to keep it in your photos. It works at the door even without a network.

expired.title: This seat has gone back
expired.body: The hold on this invite ran out. If you'd still like to come, ask {inviter} whether a seat is free.

cancelled.title: This invite is no longer active
cancelled.body: Ask the person who invited you if you think this is a mistake.

closed.title: The list is closed
closed.body: Invitations for {event} are no longer open.

in_app_browser.hint: Trouble with this page? Open it in Chrome

chase._about: Labels and system lines used by the No chase moves in content/no-chase.json.

guest.network: The connection dropped. Tap again when you're back online.

landing._about: The front door at the root address and on unknown paths. Never any event details.
landing.title: By invitation only
landing.body: Every envelope here is sealed for one person. If one was meant for you, it arrives by hand.
landing.sealed: Still sealed. It only opens for the person it was written for.

login.title: Members only
login.body: Enter your phone number and the key the host sent you.
login.error: That doesn't match. Ask the host to check your number or reset your key.
login.devices_full: This number is already signed in on three phones. Ask the host to reset your key.

home.slots_none: You've used all your invites. Expired invites come back to you automatically.
home.empty: No one yet. Your first invite is one tap away.
home.guests_empty: Your guests show here once you send their invites.

new_invite.title: Who's coming?
new_invite.phone_help: The invite only opens with this number.
new_invite.duplicate_error: This number already has an invite.
new_invite.capacity_warning: The venue is nearly full. This invite may be one of the last.
new_invite.sent_note: Sent. You'll see when they open it.
new_invite.phone_error: That number doesn't look right. Try it with the first 0, like 0803 123 4567.

new_invite.pay_help: Adds a line telling them it's covered. You'll get the transfer details right after.
new_invite.copied: Message copied. Paste it into their chat.
new_invite.slots_short: You have {left} invites left. Remove someone to continue.
new_invite.capacity_full: The venue is full. No more invites can go out.
new_invite.ready_help: Send each one from your own WhatsApp. Every message carries its own link and key.
new_invite.all_sent: All sent. Each envelope opens only for the number you entered.
new_invite.comp_help: You're covering it. They get in without paying.

guest_actions.reset_confirm: This makes a new key and signs them out of any phone. Send the new key right after.
guest_actions.cancel_confirm: Cancel {guest}'s invite? The slot comes back to you. This can't be undone.

pay_for_guest.title: Pay for {guest}
pay_for_guest.intro: Transfer the exact amount with {guest}'s reference. When it's confirmed, {guest} goes straight to their card after tapping Yes.
pay_for_guest.done: Thanks. The hosts will confirm it shortly, then {guest} goes straight to their card after tapping Yes.

detail.reset_done: New key ready. Send it now so they can get back in.
detail.cancel_done: Invite cancelled. The slot is yours again.
detail.paying_note: You're paying for {guest}. Waiting for the hosts to confirm.

pay_sheet.title: Pay for {guest}
pay_sheet.intro: Transfer the exact amount from any bank app. {guest} gets in the moment the host confirms it.
pay_sheet.sent: Payment sent. The host will confirm it.

common.error_network: The connection dropped. Nothing you typed is lost. Try again.

login.title: Host access
login.prototype: Prototype: any email and password works.
login.error: That email and password don't match. Try again.
login.footnote: Only the host signs in here.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Everything that counts is paid. Everything else is a maybe.
overview.capacity_note: {left} seats left before the venue is full.

payments.title: Payments to confirm
payments.empty: Nothing waiting. Every claim is settled.
payments.warning: Check your bank app before confirming. Never confirm from a screenshot or a forwarded alert.
payments.not_found_confirm: Send {guest} back to the transfer screen? They'll see a note to check the amount and try again.
payments.manual_match: Match a transfer without a reference
payments.subtitle: Claims waiting for a look at the bank app. Oldest first.
payments.duplicate: Two payments for this guest. Confirm one and leave the other.
payments.not_found_toast: {guest} will see a note to check the transfer.

payments.confirm_note: Confirm only after you see it in the bank app.

members.title: Members
members.remove_confirm: Remove {member}? Their unpaid invites are cancelled and paid guests stay on the list.
members.subtitle: The people who can send invites, and how many each can send.
members.key_ready: Key ready for {member}. Send it now. You won't see it again.
members.key_message: {member}, you can now send invites for {event}. Open {link} and sign in with your number and this key: {key}. Keep it to yourself.
members.duplicate_error: This number is already on the team.

event.title: Event settings
event.name_help: Guests see this on the envelope and their card.
event.capacity_help: Optional. Guests never see this number.
event.hold_help: Counted from when the guest first opens the invite. Paused while a payment is awaiting confirmation.
event.refund_default: All payments are final. No refunds.
event.subtitle: Every detail guests see, and exactly when they see it.
event.preview_help: Updates as you type. The envelope stays sealed until the key matches.

errors.name: Add the event name.
errors.date: Add both the date and the start time.
errors.end_date: Pick a last day after the first day.
errors.too_many_days: An event can run for {n} days at most.
errors.hold: Use a whole number of hours from 1 to {max}.

event.days_help: Give any day its own name or dress code. Leave a box empty to use the main one.

card.title: Card design
card.help: How the guest's card and ticket look. Only guests who unlock their invite see it.
card.note_help: Optional. For example, Champagne on arrival.

account.title: Payout account
account.body: Guests transfer straight to this account. They only see it after tapping Yes.
account.name_help: Guests see this name. Make sure it clearly reads as the hosts.
account.switch_note: Guests already on the transfer screen keep the account they were shown.
account.subtitle: Where every naira lands. Nobody takes a cut.
account.empty: No account yet. Add one before invites go out.

errors.name: Add the name guests will see.

account.delete_body: Guests won't see this account any more.
account.delete_body_active: Guests pay into this account right now. Your newest other account takes over. With no other account, guests can't pay until you add one.
account.archived: Account removed. It stays in your records because payments used it.

door.title: Door
door.download: Download the list for offline use

door.subtitle: Scan the card, or search the list if a phone is being difficult.

door.offline: Offline. Using the list saved on this phone.

board.title: Most stubborn guests of {year}
board.subtitle: They fought the No button. The No button won.

guests.title: Guests
guests.subtitle: Every invite, who sent it, and where it stands.

invite.subtitle: Your own invites. You have Unlimited.

activity.wrong_attempt: Someone tried the wrong key on {guest}'s envelope
activity.empty: Nothing yet. The first envelope will show up here.

admins.title: Admins
admins.subtitle: People who sign in here and run the event with you.

admins.phone_help: Their setup link goes to this number on WhatsApp.

setup.expired_body: Ask the person who added you for a new one.
